I fixed the typos in the four default conventions, all in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `*Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I didn't add new tests, so the specific cases from your description (`.htm` pages, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js`, `build-gradle.js`) aren't exercised by any test.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They are now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **Generated code:** the `.NET` assembly documentation rule and the `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule used `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only match a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`. Hand-written files still stay out of the generated scope, because those rules also check the file's content.
- **Build and deployment:** the Gradle JavaScript rule was `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, which only matched a file literally named `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I didn't commit anything.
